automataProblem: I created an individual academic project to visualise formal automata and make their simulation accessible through a web application.
automataFeatures: DFA and NFA, including ε-transitions; step-by-step simulation; creating and editing automata; saving state; import and export with JSON/.fas and LocalStorage; multiple interface languages; light and dark themes. Pushdown automata and Turing machines are experimental directions.
automataArchitecture: I implemented the SPA in Elm using Model–View–Update. LocalStorage stores data locally; JSON/.fas files support saving and loading models. I deployed the application on GitHub Pages.
automataLearned: I gained experience with Elm, functional programming, SPA architecture, formal automata and algorithm visualisation.
automataStatus: Completed and defended as my bachelor's thesis at FIIT STU.
